name: PT Mandiri Herindo Adiperkasa Tbk
summary: PT Mandiri Herindo Adiperkasa Tbk is a logistics provider specializing in the transportation of minerals and coal throughout Indonesia. Its operations are supported by a diverse fleet of vehicles, including various configurations of single and double trailers, as well as numerous dump trucks. Additionally, the company offers essential mining support services, specifically aiding in coal hauling activities. Established in 1994, PT Mandiri Herindo Adiperkasa Tbk maintains its corporate headquarters in Jakarta, Indonesia.
